dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 mainframe program, part of the HCAZ transaction suite (healthcare patient inquiry). Uses EXEC CICS, EXEC SQL with SQLCA, DFHCOMMAREA, EIB fields (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN).
evidence: COMP usage for DB2 host variables

purpose.domain_detail: Hospital/clinic patient inquiry system; retrieves patient demographic and insurance details from a DB2 PATIENT table via CICS transaction HCAZ option 2.
purpose.summary: HCIPDB01 is a CICS online subprogram invoked by transaction HCAZ to inquire on a patient record. It validates the commarea, issues a DB2 SELECT against the PATIENT table using the patient ID, and returns patient details (name, DOB, insurance card, address, contact info) via the commarea.

notable_features: DFHCOMMAREA with EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA
EIB field usage (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN)
COPY HCERRSWS and COPY HCERRSPD for error handling
Commented-out bug injection markers (%bug1, %bug2) suggesting training/demo use
SQLCODE EVALUATE for DB2 error handling
Host variable DB2-PATIENT-ID PIC S9(9) COMP
verdict.notes: The %bug markers and comment 'Look for %bug to introduce bugs' suggest this may be part of a training or demo environment (possibly IBM Z learning materials), but the code structure is fully production-quality CICS/DB2 COBOL. No lines exceed 72 characters confirming fixed format. The INCLUDE HCCMAREA inside LINKAGE SECTION via EXEC SQL is an unusual but valid IBM pattern for commarea copybooks.
